notes.title: Aplestia is out! (-20% launch offer)
notes.content:
Enjoy and don't forget to write a review, be it positive or negative - we want to become better! ːsteamhappyː


Helpful Tips:
[list][*]Configure your sound volume from the options.
[*]Change your FPS Synch option if you lag a bit during gameplay.
[*]Quicker battles - click on the musical note during battle or press Shift.
[*]The -20% offer will be on for a week![/list]

PS: Trading Cards will be available when the game sells "enough" according to steam.
